_meta.title: Measured constants for the 2026-27 model, re-derived on 2026-11-17
_meta.rule: measure, never fit. Each constant states the official column it came from.

league.formula: sum(OffRtg_i * POSS_i) / sum(POSS_i) over the 30 official rows; PACE weighted by GP

dispersion.formula: sample standard deviation (n-1) of the official home-minus-away margin and of the official game total, over every decided game in the corpus, de-duplicated by game id

home_court_pin.formula: HCA_points = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(home_win_rate); the rate comes from the official standings HOME/ROAD columns, never from a fit
